Log-likelihood of a fitted mvgam model

Source: R/log_lik.mvgam.R
logLik.mvgam.Rd

The posterior mean of the summed log likelihood, with the df and nobs attributes that stats::AIC() and stats::BIC() use.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'mvgam'
logLik(object, pointwise = FALSE, ...)

Arguments

object

A fitted mvgam object.

pointwise

Logical. TRUE returns the [ndraws, nobs] matrix of log_lik.mvgam(). Defaults to FALSE.

...

Further arguments to log_lik.mvgam(), such as newdata or ndraws.

Value

A logLik object. df counts the parameters variables() lists. With pointwise = TRUE, the matrix of log_lik.mvgam().

Details

Each latent state counts as a parameter, which makes AIC and BIC coarse for a state-space model. loo.mvgam() estimates the ELPD with diagnostics for its reliability.

See also

log_lik.mvgam() returns the pointwise matrix.
